x: George Bentley is not quite fit yet and if Frank Tasker would only take the bit between his teeth and have a go he would find he can do the distance, and get there too.

Jack Baker came next but at the half distance George Bentley who owing to his recent heavy studying has been unable to get fit, retired. Ted Evans, walking as an individual at his own expense for experience sake, showed up to advantage.
Further back, George Oliver, Tony Bellchamber and George Bentley were still walking strongly, especially Tony, who was walking like an old hand.

George Bentley stayed behind to accompany Syd to hospital, but the incident undoubtedly upset Jack and completely put him off his form. We are pleased to report that Syd is now fully recovered and would like to thank all those who kept his wife busy at the phone enquiring as to his welfare.) However…
Incidentally, George Atkinson's father was the first individual winner in this race. Bob Readman (6th) and George Bentley (11th) gave us 7 in the first 16 out of a finishing field of 66.

Eventually our lads finished in a procession with five consecutive placings from 18 to 22 and backed up by George Bentley, Joe Wilson and Joe Coleman, we succeeded in taking the Nijmegan Shield with our eight walkers in the first 48, an excellent performance on which all are to be congratulated.
